name: c-testing
description: Aula C: guía de enseñanza con laboratorio C/WebAssembly.

scripts.prepare:content: node scripts/prepare.mjs && tailwindcss -c scripts/tailwind.config.cjs -i web/css/legacy-input.css -o web/public/legacy/tailwind.css --minify
scripts.format: prettier --write web/*.html web/js web/css scripts docs PROJECT_BRAIN package.json package-lock.json vite.config.js firebase.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web/*.html web/js web/css scripts docs PROJECT_BRAIN package.json package-lock.json vite.config.js firebase.json README.md
scripts.quick: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && git diff --check
